metadata.statuteRef: Colo. Rev. Stat. § 8-4-101 et seq. & COMPS Order #39

standards.stateTaxName: CO FAMLI (Family and Medical Leave Insurance)
specialRules: COMPS Order #39 mandates an annual exempt salary of at least $55,000 ($1,057.69/wk).
Colorado requires 1.5x overtime after 12 hours worked in a single workday or 12 consecutive hours.
Deductions for cash shortages or property damage are strictly restricted under C.R.S. § 8-4-105.
